why: A (universes 0): Lemma 8.1 for the induced connection of a slice submanifold N ⊆ V: covDeriv (P_{c(t)} X') satisfies the project's IsCovDerivAlong (axioms (a)-(c) on smooth tangent fields ℝ → V), and any D satisfying them equals covDeriv on smooth fields along a smooth curve (proved with the global frame Eᵢ(q) = P_q eᵢ instead of coordinate fields). B: Lemma 8.1 for an ARBITRARY smooth Mathlib connection on an abstract ℝⁿ-manifold: some D on sections of TM over c satisfies (a)-(c), and it is unique on smooth fields. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: B's existence needs Milnor's coordinate formula DV/dt = Σ(dvᵏ/dt + Σ u̇ⁱΓᵏᵢⱼvʲ)∂ₖ, i.e. Christoffel symbols of an arbitrary connection in charts and patching along c, and its uniqueness needs global extensions of coordinate fields; the project has neither (Connection.lean: Christoffel symbols and covariant derivative along curves 'not formalized' for abstract connections), and Whitney embedding does not turn B's connection into the induced one. B ⇒ A fails genuinely: B's objects are abstract; it does not specialize to the project's covDeriv on maps ℝ → V, which is not a Mathlib CovariantDerivative construction. Not even a vacuous re-proof was attempted (the project's uniqueness proof eq_sum is ~40 lines).
B_issue: B assumes neither Hausdorffness nor second countability; Milnor's uniqueness argument extends coordinate fields to global fields with bump functions, standard only for Hausdorff manifolds.
embedded_special_case_note: Items/V6_6.lean, namespace Emb. B_emb := B at M = Bridge.Sub hN (model ℝⁿ), cov = Bridge.conn (B_to_B_emb, via Bridge.conn_contMDiff). Two transports of operators along a curve c in ↥N: toProj Dm X t = D_{c t}(Dm (L∘X) t) (Mathlib-level D/dt ↦ project-level, toProj_isCovDerivAlong: B's axioms ⇒ Morse.IsCovDerivAlong + PresSmooth) and toMath Dp U t = L_{c t}(Dp (ambA c U) t) (toMath_isCovDerivAlong, needs PresSmooth), with toProj_toMath on smooth tangent fields. Proved B_emb_iff_A81, where A81 = Lemma 8.1 in the project's vocabulary with B's notion of operator: ∃ D satisfying Morse.IsCovDerivAlong and carrying smooth tangent fields to smooth tangent fields (PresSmooth), unique among such operators on smooth tangent fields, for N with model ℝⁿ. A_to_A81 (D = covDeriv; uses both of A's theorems), hence A_to_B_emb; B_to_A81. Both #rt_check OK; overlap of B_to_A81 with A's proofs: 96 slice-chart/Gram-projection infrastructure lemmas (contMDiff_tanProj, tanCoord_mfderiv_val, ...) reached through the Bridge plus the field projections of Morse.IsCovDerivAlong; neither eq_sum nor covDeriv_add/smul/comp is shared. What B_emb lacks relative to A: the identification D = P(X') (A's isCovDerivAlong_covDeriv, B only asserts existence), uniqueness among operators that do not preserve smoothness (B builds smoothness preservation into IsCovDerivAlong, the project does not), and models Z ≠ ℝⁿ. Dictionary lemmas added (Emb): isSmoothCurve_iff', isSmoothAlong_iff' (Bridge's within-s versions at s = univ), isFieldAlong_ambA, liftA/ambA_liftA/liftA_ambA/isSmoothAlong_liftA, D_velocity (B's mfderiv velocity ↦ Morse.velocity), liftF/amb_liftF/conn_liftF. The original 'why' remark that B 'does not specialize to the project's covDeriv' is superseded by this section; the A/B verdict (no direction, incomparable) is unchanged since A1 and A2's full uniqueness are not consequences of B.
